title: Newest update of AI GM on web chat bot
author: Solid-Funny-668
selftext:
AI-GM-Engine turns an Web AI chat into a game master for a persistent-world RPG. You load the engine files plus a background (the setting), then play in plain words. The AI runs the world, rolls the dice, and keeps track of everything.   
  
Free decision.

The world doesn’t wait for you. NPCs have their own plans and act on them, jobs come and go, and danger rises or falls depending on where you are. Dice only decide what the setting and the characters can’t. Your character grows through XP and real use of skills, and progress is kept in save files you can reload any time.

Backgrounds cover different settings, and long campaigns continue in chapters, each one built from where the last ended.

Free and open under MIT: [github.com/west132/AI-GM-Engine](http://github.com/west132/AI-GM-Engine)
